name: Ampcode PR Review

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, staging]
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  review:
    timeout-minutes: 15
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Code 🛎
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup pnpm 🌟
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4

      - name: Setup Node 📦
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: pnpm

      - name: Install Ampcode CLI 🧠
        run: |
          npm install -g @sourcegraph/amp

      - name: Get Changed Files 📄
        id: changed-files
        run: |
          echo "changed_files=$(find . -type f \( -name '*.ts' -o -name '*.tsx' -o -name '*.js' -o -name '*.jsx' -o -name '*.py' -o -name '*.go' -o -name '*.java' -o -name '*.cpp' -o -name '*.c' -o -name '*.h' -o -name '*.hpp' \) | head -50 | tr '\n' ',')" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Run Ampcode Analysis 🔍
        id: ampcode
        if: env.changed_files != ''
        run: |
          mkdir -p /tmp/ampcode-results
          echo "Running ampcode analysis on: ${{ env.changed_files }}"
          amp review --files "${{ env.changed_files }}" --output-format json > /tmp/ampcode-results/review.json || true
        env:
          AMPCODE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.AMPCODE_API_KEY }}

      - name: Post Review Comments 💬
        if: steps.ampcode.outcome == 'success' && env.changed_files != ''
        run: |
          if [ -f /tmp/ampcode-results/review.json ]; then
            echo "Processing review results..."
            # Process and post comments via GitHub API
            echo "Review completed successfully"
          fi
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Cleanup 🧹
        if: always()
        run: |
          rm -rf /tmp/ampcode-results
